rc.note: Information only; not a criterion. Implemented from the description in Sullivan, Timmermann and White [d09]; White (2000) itself was not read.

notes: History uses today's index members (survivorship bias); this flatters strategies that buy past winners.
Validation is history (seen): season 1, the retired desk and 12 earlier tests looked at 2016 onward; never out of sample.
After tax by default; no dividends are credited and cash earns 0%.
banner: Backtests use today's index members (survivorship bias) and were designed after reading the research; running many strategies makes the best one look better than it is. Only the live record since 2026-09-30 is out of sample.
